smart_box.name: SBBox-BookCatalog
smart_box.description: Smart Box responsible for exposing the logical structure and content references of the educational book.

book.description: Logical structure and content references of the book.

rules: BookCatalog exposes the logical structure of the book.
BookCatalog uses stable identifiers for books, pages, and narrations.
Pages are exposed in logical reading order.
BookCatalog may expose a narration identifier associated with a page.
BookCatalog does not resolve provider-specific narration resources.
BookCatalog does not render or load images.
BookCatalog does not control narration playback.
BookCatalog does not depend on a specific technology or provider.
BookCatalog exposes WHAT is available, not HOW resources are implemented.
